name: Test1
title: Test 1
description: A conversation between Sophia and Ethan about visiting a local art exhibition
instructions: You will hear two conversations with following context.
Passage1 Context: A student is speaking with a library staff member about an overdue book.
Passage2 Context: A part-time employee is asking their manager to change their work hours
Each conversation is followed by a set of multiple-choice questions.
Choose the best answer for each question.

passages.title: Library Late Fee and Renewal Discussion
passages.setting: Two friends are deciding how to celebrate a birthday on a limited budget

conversation.name: Library Staff
conversation.text: Hi there. Are you here to return a book?

conversation.name: Student
conversation.text: Yes. I just realized it’s overdue by a few days.

conversation.name: Library Staff
conversation.text: Let me check… Okay, it’s 3 days late, so that’s a $1.50 fine.

conversation.name: Student
conversation.text: No problem. Can I still renew it for another two weeks?

conversation.name: Library Staff
conversation.text: Actually, someone else has placed a hold on it, so it needs to be returned today.

conversation.name: Student
conversation.text: Got it. I’ll just pay the fine and return it.

questions.question: Why did the student approach the library staff?

choices.text: To complain about a lost book
To pay a late return fine
To apply for a study room

questions.question: Why can’t the student renew the book?

choices.text: The student reached the limit of renewals
Someone else has requested the book

passages.title: Workplace Schedule Adjustment Request
passages.setting: A part-time employee is asking their manager to change their work hours.

conversation.name: Employee
conversation.text: Hi, I was wondering if I could switch my shift this Thursday.

conversation.name: Employee
conversation.text: I have an exam in the evening, and my shift is from 5 to 9.

conversation.name: Manager
conversation.text: Hmm. Let me check… We could move you to the afternoon shift—1 to 5.

conversation.name: Employee
conversation.text: That would be perfect. Thank you!

conversation.name: Manager
conversation.text: No problem. I’ll update the schedule.

questions.question: Why does the employee want to change their shift?

choices.text: They are working a second job

questions.question: What time is the new shift scheduled for?
What is the manager’s final response?

choices.text: They’ll approve it for next week
The employee must find a replacement.
The change will be made to the schedule
